claim: DESIGN.md §2.1: the mechanism that took one real graph's compliance from 74% to 94%
source: oss-agent, on the SDS corpus, 2026-08-27 (v0.28.0 and v0.28.1)
how: Not reproducible in this repository and not a claim about alchemy. It is the measurement that motivated the vocabulary-partitioned extractor, made in another codebase against another corpus, and it is written down here so that citing it stays a citation. The last step of it was 92% to 94%, closing twenty non-compliant configured_by edges after the model was found treating command-line flags as entities.
